items.title: Focus indicator design
items.reason: Space opened the row with focus retained and a visible 2px focus ring; shared input/button styles also define focus-visible rings.

items.title: Keyboard navigation patterns

items.title: ARIA pattern library
items.reason: Fields have associated labels, but required stars are aria-hidden and the Inputs omit required/aria-required.
items.impact: Required status is visible as a red star but unavailable as an input semantic to assistive technology.
items.fix: Set required or aria-required on every required category/subcategory input while retaining associated labels.
items.verify: Inspect the accessibility tree and confirm required state is announced by a screen reader.

items.title: Header
items.reason: Headers identify each category, code and subcategory count.

items.title: Expand/collapse icon
items.reason: Collapsed and expanded rows show directional chevrons.

items.title: Content area
items.reason: Associated category fields and subcategories appear within the expanded row.

items.title: States
items.reason: Category summaries have a focus ring; Add category summary omits equivalent focus styling and neither summary defines an explicit hover treatment.
items.impact: Add category does not share the category rows’ explicit focus treatment; hover gives no additional affordance.
items.fix: Reuse one summary style with focus-visible ring and subtle hover background for all expandable groups.
items.verify: Tab through both summary types and compare focus/hover in light and dark themes.

items.title: Expanding logic
items.reason: Independent native details allow multiple expanded categories; search expands matching rows.

items.title: Base style
items.reason: Uses shared Button defaults with primary Save, outline secondary actions and ghost archive controls.

items.title: Shape
items.reason: Shared size, padding, border and radius variants are reused.

items.title: Variants
items.reason: Primary Save is visually distinct from secondary Cancel and row actions.

items.title: Copy
items.reason: Edit, Save changes, Add category and Archive category identify actions; Confirm is contextualized by the dialog title.

items.title: States
items.reason: Shared states are defined and disabled Save was observed, but all hover/focus/pressed combinations were not exercised.
items.verify: Run the named check against the live screen in its relevant themes/states; record direct evidence before claiming it passes.

items.title: Input field
items.reason: Text inputs accept edits and retain focus when a code changes.

items.title: Label
items.reason: Visible labels are associated, but required semantics are absent on their Inputs.
items.impact: Required status is visible as a red star but unavailable as an input semantic to assistive technology.
items.fix: Set required or aria-required on every required category/subcategory input while retaining associated labels.
items.verify: Inspect the accessibility tree and confirm required state is announced by a screen reader.

items.title: Placeholder text
items.reason: Persistent explicit labels identify these short fields; repeating every label as placeholder would add noise. Search has its own purpose placeholder.

items.title: Data format
items.reason: Uppercase/max length are applied, but BAD! can be added and format restrictions are only reported by a toast after Save.
items.impact: Users must infer which code is invalid and may miss an ephemeral toast.
items.fix: Add code-format guidance and associated inline errors with aria-invalid/aria-describedby; validate after blur/submit, expand and focus the first invalid field, and clear errors on correction.
items.verify: Enter BAD! in category and subcategory codes, blur and submit; check local error, focus, retained draft and successful correction.

items.title: Illustration or icon
items.reason: Per-input illustration is unnecessary for this compact taxonomy editor; the existing toolbar/search icons provide hierarchy.

items.title: Hint
items.reason: Stable-code help exists, but allowed letters/digits/hyphen/underscore are not described next to code fields.
items.impact: Users must infer which code is invalid and may miss an ephemeral toast.
items.fix: Add code-format guidance and associated inline errors with aria-invalid/aria-describedby; validate after blur/submit, expand and focus the first invalid field, and clear errors on correction.
items.verify: Enter BAD! in category and subcategory codes, blur and submit; check local error, focus, retained draft and successful correction.

items.title: Input field
items.reason: Search input accepted Coaching and reduced the list to one matching expanded row.

items.title: Label or placeholder text
items.reason: Accessible label and placeholder explicitly describe category/subcategory search.

items.title: Quick links, autocomplete and suggestions
items.reason: Immediate local filtering of a small settings list needs no history-based suggestion system.

items.title: Submit search button
items.reason: Search filters locally while typing; a separate submit action would add an unnecessary step.

items.title: Previous searches
items.reason: This bounded taxonomy list does not require stored prior searches.

items.title: Appropriate visibility
items.reason: Search is scoped correctly in read mode but disabled throughout Edit, preventing locating another category while editing.
items.impact: Long lists cannot be searched while making edits.
items.fix: Keep drafts in parent state keyed by stable row IDs so search can stay enabled without discarding hidden edits.
items.verify: Type an unadded subcategory, filter away/back, and verify draft persistence and safe Save behaviour.

items.title: Spacing scale
items.reason: Uses gap-2/3/4 and p-3/4 from the shared spacing scale.

items.title: Semantic spacing tokens
items.reason: Card uses shared spacing variables, but row/section gaps use numeric utilities rather than named component/layout roles.
items.impact: Future spacing changes require editing repeated row/section utility classes.
items.fix: If this taxonomy editor pattern is reused, extract shared row/section spacing tokens rather than introducing a separate visual scale.
items.verify: Compare all taxonomy editor spacing after changing the shared token.

items.title: Column grid
items.reason: Code/name/action columns align, with stack layout at narrow widths; a global 12-column grid is unnecessary for this bounded editor.

items.title: Breakpoints
items.reason: Shared sm breakpoint switches the three-column field row into a vertical stack.

items.title: Component vs layout spacing
items.reason: Row separation uses gap-2; expanded sections use gap-4 and p-4; controls use shared compact sizing.

items.title: Density variants
items.reason: The compact editor plus user-controlled expansion is sufficient; an extra density preference is not required.

items.title: Baseline grid alignment
items.reason: Shared control heights and items-end align category/subcategory code/name/actions.

items.title: Type scale
items.reason: Shared CardTitle, text-sm and text-xs distinguish title, form labels and metadata.

items.title: Semantic text styles
items.reason: Product categories is a styled div, while Subcategories uses h3 without a corresponding screen-section h2.
items.impact: Heading navigation skips the visible Product categories section title.
items.fix: Render Product categories as h2, preserving CardTitle styling and subordinate h3 sections.
items.verify: Inspect visible heading structure and navigate headings with NVDA/VoiceOver.

items.title: Typeface selection and loading
items.reason: Inter/Geist font variables are loaded with next/font and shared heading/body/mono styles are reused.

items.title: Line height per style
items.reason: Shared component and Tailwind text styles provide title/body/control line heights.

items.title: Letter spacing per style
items.reason: No special tracking is needed for these normal form labels; existing type defaults are retained.

items.title: Responsive type behaviour
items.reason: The screen fits 1440/768/375px widths through layout stacking and wrapping, without requiring fluid type scaling.

items.title: Minimum readable size
items.reason: 12px metadata is visible in the screenshot; real-device readability was not tested.
items.verify: Run the named check against the live screen in its relevant themes/states; record direct evidence before claiming it passes.

items.title: Accessibility responsiveness
items.reason: Responsive viewport resizing is not a substitute for actual browser zoom testing.
items.verify: Run the named check against the live screen in its relevant themes/states; record direct evidence before claiming it passes.

items.reason: The Product categories screen sits in the Taxonomy group with clear category/subcategory organization.

items.title: Account details

items.title: Security details

items.title: Notification preferences
items.reason: Notification preferences are unrelated to product taxonomy.

items.title: Billing
items.reason: No payment or plan changes occur in this screen.

items.reason: These preferences belong to separate settings; this screen inherits the current theme.

items.title: Danger zone
items.reason: Archive controls are separate from identity inputs and open a confirmation explaining that saving applies the change and in-use codes are blocked.

items.title: Keep the input in default state
items.reason: Inputs begin without premature error styling; unchanged Save remains disabled.

items.title: Allow user to enter information
items.reason: Code entry retains focus and accepts user typing without validation interruption.

items.title: Signal error after loss of focus
items.reason: BAD! reached Save and produced only a toast; zero aria-invalid fields and no local corrective message were present.
items.impact: Users must infer which code is invalid and may miss an ephemeral toast.
items.fix: Add code-format guidance and associated inline errors with aria-invalid/aria-describedby; validate after blur/submit, expand and focus the first invalid field, and clear errors on correction.
items.verify: Enter BAD! in category and subcategory codes, blur and submit; check local error, focus, retained draft and successful correction.

items.title: Return to default state upon reattempt
items.reason: There is no field-level error state to clear/revalidate during correction; errors remain detached in toasts.
items.impact: Users must infer which code is invalid and may miss an ephemeral toast.
items.fix: Add code-format guidance and associated inline errors with aria-invalid/aria-describedby; validate after blur/submit, expand and focus the first invalid field, and clear errors on correction.
items.verify: Enter BAD! in category and subcategory codes, blur and submit; check local error, focus, retained draft and successful correction.

items.title: Show button to submit
items.reason: Save is in the standard shared header; new-category/subcategory forms place Add after their fields. Header placement is appropriate for this settings editor.

items.title: Show loading state after submission
items.reason: Saving… and disabled controls are implemented; a delayed successful request was not exercised.
items.verify: Run the named check against the live screen in its relevant themes/states; record direct evidence before claiming it passes.

items.title: Show success message when it submits
items.reason: Success toast and baseline reset are implemented; this audit did not persist a successful settings mutation.
items.verify: Run the named check against the live screen in its relevant themes/states; record direct evidence before claiming it passes.

items.title: If it doesn't, show an error message
items.reason: Invalid code submission produced the server error toast and preserved unsaved changes.

items.title: An error may occur because of the wrong information
items.reason: The error text identifies the format restriction, but is not attached to the affected field and focus is not moved to it.
items.impact: Users must infer which code is invalid and may miss an ephemeral toast.
items.fix: Add code-format guidance and associated inline errors with aria-invalid/aria-describedby; validate after blur/submit, expand and focus the first invalid field, and clear errors on correction.
items.verify: Enter BAD! in category and subcategory codes, blur and submit; check local error, focus, retained draft and successful correction.

limitations: No measured contrast, colour-vision simulation, actual 200% browser zoom or runtime light-theme pass.
No delayed save or successful persisted save in this audit; invalid server submission was exercised and cancelled.
